scope: Read-only communication, residual-stream, attention-layout and graph source review. No contributed code execution, no GPU requests, no runtime modification. Installed baseline communicator retrieved by read-only docker cp.

baseline.mechanism: input clone, asynchronous XCCL all_reduce, work.wait
baseline.dtype: FP16 target activations/native KV; official FP8 target weights; MTP1 unchanged

message_geometry.warning: Model row arithmetic only; this is not a measured collective size histogram.

findings.disposition: Worth a separate bounded engineering feasibility task, not a quick adoption
findings.portable_mechanism: Push exact input bytes into fixed double-buffered peer scratch, per-block device sequence and handshake, local sum into separate output; avoids input clone and generic collective path
constraints: AMD HIP IPC/fine-grained coherence/store drain must be replaced with proven Level Zero/SYCL ordering, not copied.
FP32 add followed by FP16 cast must be bitwise qualified against XCCL, including subnormal/cancellation/overflow/signed-zero cases.
Two ranks only, contiguous 16-byte aligned messages; changing message/block shape and counter reuse need lifecycle tests.
Do not transplant spin timeout: current source breaks after 4 billion iterations and continues reduction without an error result.
Existing R199c profile is older and wait-heavy; its summed collective time is not removable wall time.
Idea already proposed by lab R199c; Radiance/StillDeadcode add a concrete implementation reference.

findings.idea: Match collective dispatch thresholds to real prefill message sizes
findings.disposition: Adopt as audit/accounting practice only; no missing RADIANCE setting on XCCL
constraints: Radiance 48 MiB cap covers 4096x5120x2=40 MiB, fails at8192=80 MiB.
Existing B70 launcher already sets three XCCL SIMPLE thresholds to4GiB; no equivalent 48MiB Radiance fallback observed.
Radiance geometry knobs affect six-bit compressed path; its reported prefills gains are not qualified exact-path measurements.

findings.disposition: Potential larger FP16-only future port, not directly transferable ARNQ
constraints: Radiance emits FP8 activations/scales for W4A8; B70 intentionally uses FP16 activations.
Exact_nq name describes underlying reduce, not global exactness against our target; SiLU path source admits code differences.
FP16-only epilogue would need existing row-invariant normalization accumulation/rounding and aliasing preserved.

findings.disposition: Hardware/backend-specific or correctness lesson, no current B70 runtime adoption
